artworks.title: Nicandro and Amarilli
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an outdoor setting. The drawing depicts one central figure, possibly an old man with a beard, using a staff or cane, standing on the left-hand side. He is gesturing towards a group on the right that appear to be engaged in an intense action. The group consists of several figures positioned closely together, with some kneeling or bending over, possibly attending to something or interacting with each other. The background is filled with sketchy outlines of trees and clouds, giving a sense of an outdoor scene. The drawing is made with fine lines and hatching to create shading and form. The style suggests an illustration or preparatory sketch, focusing on capturing movement and emotion.

artworks.title: Linco, Silvio and Dorinda
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash lightly squared in graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures engaged in a gentle interaction. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking down on the scene. Softly sketched trees and foliage create a high horizon, framing the background. The artwork features loose brushstrokes, emphasizing movement and fluidity. The color palette is muted with shades of brown, grey, and hints of blue, enhancing the tranquil quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Chorus of Shepherds: Carino, Montano and Mirtillo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group scene. The image shows an outdoor gathering in front of a grand architectural structure. The structure has columns and banners. Numerous figures are shown, facing central figures near the doorway. An animal, possibly a dog, is present. The detailed hatching and line work give depth and movement to the scene. Background elements suggest architecture and landscape. Soft tones and careful detailing add to the historic or classical feel of the composition.

artworks.title: Corisca, Amarilli and Mirtillo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an outdoor setting. The scene includes multiple figures in motion or interacting with each other. The background features elements like clouds and structures. Three figures on the right side are gesturing energetically. The atmosphere conveys drama or eventfulness, possibly a narrative or theatrical moment. The drawing uses light brown tones and sketch-like strokes, giving it a dynamic quality. The title at the bottom reveals the names Corisca, Amarilli, and Mirsillo.

artworks.title: Corisca
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image presents a scene with a figure standing amidst a natural setting. The horizon is low, with hills and clusters of vegetation in the background. Delicate brushstrokes create movement and texture in the foliage and clouds. The color palette is muted, primarily in shades of brown and gray. The figure holds a staff or spear-like object, with a landscape of vegetation in the distance blending into the sky.

artworks.title: Silvio and Dorinda
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with foliage and vegetation. The sketch shows delicate brushstrokes defining the texture of leaves and the figure's garments, with intricate line work outlining forms. The color palette is mainly brown and gray, creating a monochromatic look. A figure is present in the foreground with a bow, while trees and greenery extend into the distance, suggesting a forest setting.

artworks.title: Chorus of Hunters and Shepherds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of figures engaged in a game or contest. The scene shows multiple figures in opposing positions, each holding a staff or pole. The background is filled with swirling lines, creating a sense of movement. The figures are rendered with simple but expressive forms, emphasizing their dynamic motion. The composition is dense, focusing on the central action. The artwork features a monochromatic color palette and a detailed yet sketch-like quality, giving it a lively and spontaneous look.

artworks.title: Silvio, Dorinda and Linco
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in an embrace or supportive pose in a dense, sketchy woodland setting. The drawing uses pen and ink techniques with fine lines, cross-hatching, and expressive strokes for texture and depth. The color palette consists of soft sepia tones, emphasizing the detailed line work. The trees in the distance frame the central group of figures who appear to be leaning on each other.

artworks.title: Chorus of Shepherds and Ergasto
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figure-like forms in a dynamic background. The image shows a person gesturing towards a group of seated figures. The background includes dense foliage and sketchy outlines, hinting at a natural outdoor setting. The composition highlights movement through the raised arm of the standing figure. The figures appear engaged in conversation or playing instruments. The drawing uses shades of brown and grey to depict the scene intricately.

artworks.title: Silvio
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a reclining figure in a natural setting surrounded by trees and foliage, with the horizon positioned high and obscured by dense foliage. The artist uses delicate brushstrokes to depict trees, clouds, and the figure. The color palette is muted, mainly grayscale with hints of yellow and brown, creating a monochromatic look. The shading creates depth and enhances the gentle ambiance of the artwork.

artworks.title: Tirenio, Montano and Carino
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with multiple figures. The setting features a spacious room with high ceilings, pillars, and a group of people wearing formal or religious attire. Some figures are engaged in interaction, with one kneeling or bending over and another gesturing with an extended arm. The observers surround them, creating a sense of occasion. In the background, a high dome ceiling and a statue on a pedestal add grandeur to the scene. The drawing is detailed with lines and shading, conveying depth and a historical essence.

artworks.title: Montano, Carino and Dameta
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene involving architecture and people. The drawing shows an ornate architectural structure resembling a classical building with columns and intricate decorations. In the foreground, there are three prominent figures wearing flowing robes and head coverings, one holding a staff. These figures are surrounded by a crowd of similarly dressed individuals extending into the background, suggesting a large assembly or procession. The scene is rendered in delicate lines and shading, conveying a sense of depth and detail, while the composition emphasizes the interaction between the central figures within a grand setting.

artworks.title: Amarilli and Mirtillo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a room interior with figures and architectural elements. The scene depicts a gathering of figures on the left side, some seated and others standing. There is a large column in the center, a vaulted ceiling, and a canopy bed with a couple on the right. Ornate details like a candle holder and a decorative urn are visible, adding richness to the room. The style appears influenced by Baroque or Renaissance architectural renderings.

artworks.title: Titiro and Messo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with two figures and a temple. The drawing depicts an encounter between two figures in the foreground, one gesturing towards the other with an open arm. The other figure appears to hold a staff and is dressed in flowing garments. In the background, there is a landscape featuring a large structure resembling a classical temple with columns and a pediment, partially obscured by trees or foliage. The scene is presented in a detailed and finely executed style, emphasizing the interaction between the figures and the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Corisca and Linco
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures against an architectural and natural background. The central figures face each other standing on a surface that incorporates sketchy details resembling waves or aquatic elements. In the background, there is a large building with columns on the left side, while the right side features sketched trees and an open sky. A figure in a boat is visible on the water to the far left.

artworks.title: Ceremony of the Contract of Marriage between Vladislas IV, King of Poland, and LouiseMarie of Gonzaga, Princess of Mantua, at Fontainbleau
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial gathering in an ornately decorated room. The individuals are dressed in elaborate attire, suggesting a formal occasion. The room features detailed tapestries, artwork, and a chandelier hanging from the ceiling. The floor has a checkerboard pattern. The drawing shows careful attention to textures and architectural elements, depicting a scene from a historical setting.

artworks.title: The King Giving the Accolade and Creating Knights of S. Michel Who Receive the Order of the Holy Spirit
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals gathered around a kneeling figure. The central figure, who appears to be of high status, is wearing a detailed coat, hat, and is being addressed by a standing man. The other men in the image are also dressed in ornate attire with lace collars. The background features grand architectural columns and a banner with text above.

artworks.title: March of the King and Knights of the Holy Spirit in the Courtyard at Fontainebleau
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27.2 x 35.5 cm (10 11/16 x 14 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial procession taking place in what appears to be an architectural setting reminiscent of a palace or grand courtyard. The structured scene shows groups of figures organized in lines, some dressed in extravagant garments featuring cloaks and ruffs. The background includes a facade of elegant, arched windows and a colonnade. The detailed garments and ornate headwear suggest high status or ceremonial significance. The scene captures the splendor and ceremonial order of the figures.

artworks.title: Meeting in the Chapel at Fontainebleau
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. The setting shows a grand hall filled with figures in historic attire. The main focus is on individuals in the center engaged in discussion. Around them, other figures observe from rows of seating against the walls. The room is ornately decorated with heavy drapery, balconies, and intricate wall designs, conveying a sense of authority and grandeur.

artworks.title: Banquet Given by the King to the New Knights
artworks.medium: etching and engraving
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 27.2 x 34.5 cm (10 11/16 x 13 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a banquet scene. The image features a banquet table with various dishes and elegantly dressed figures seated around it. The setting shows a large hall with ornate architectural details, including decorated walls and columns. At the far end of the hall, a stage is set up with more figures present. Two standing figures in the foreground point towards the center of the scene. The style and clothing suggest a depiction of a historical or Renaissance-era gathering, focusing on opulence and formality.

artworks.title: The Ponte Molle
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper, posthumous impression
artworks.description: The image presents a landscape with a stone bridge running across a river. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky filled with light clouds. The bridge is composed of several arches and stretches into the distance. A group of figures and a horse-drawn cart are near vessels by the water's edge. Rolling hills can be seen beyond the bridge. The color palette is monochrome, giving a timeless quality to the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape with Peasant and his Herd
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated position. The horizon shows rolling hills and a structure resembling a castle. Sheep are being herded by a man. Trees with gnarled branches frame the scene. An ancient stone pillar stands, with a textured surface. The color palette is mainly sepia tones and various shades of grey. Trees in the background are intricately depicted with detailed lines.

artworks.title: Jesus Telling the Parable of the Father who Sends his Workers to his Vineyard
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image depicts a classical landscape with a town nestled among hills and architectural structures. A cylindrical tower stands out in the skyline. A tree with intricate branches is on the left, with mountains in the background. Various buildings and bridges are visible in the distance, with hills further enhancing the scene's depth. The detailed line work resembles etching or engraving, adding texture to the landscape. The color scheme is monochromatic, using varying shades of black, white, and grey for contrast and depth.

artworks.title: The Levite and the Priest Pass the Man Without Helping Him
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with various elements such as mountains, a fortress-like structure on a hill, trees, water features like waterfalls and a pond. The scene is rendered in black and white, emphasizing textures and details. Two figures can be seen near the pond, with one observing the surroundings.
